name: Payment demanded as a precondition of a job
description: A job or placement offer demands an upfront fee, deposit or processing charge before employment — a fee no legitimate employer requires.

source_references.quote: Never pay for job offers. Verify job postings and companies before applying or providing personal data.

explanation.plain: This job asked you to pay a fee before you start. Real employers never ask you to pay to get a job. It is a scam.
explanation.technical: UPFRONT_FEE_DEMAND (payment-action) with a job pretext. CERT-In: never pay for job offers.
verification_steps: Never pay a fee to secure a job or placement.
Verify the company through its official website and careers page.
